column3: NKJV has “mightily with a loud voice” and lacks “a prison for every unclean beast,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “with a mighty voice” and includes it.
NKJV lacks “and spice,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text includes it.
NKJV has “you holy apostles and prophets,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “you saints and apostles and prophets.”
